newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch consumer confidence rises to +5 in August.
newsitem.headline: Dutch consumer confidence rises to +5 in August.

text.p: The Dutch consumer confidence index rose to +5 in August from +4 in July, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Monday.
DUTCH CONSUMER CONFIDENCE Aug 96 July 96 Aug 95
Note - The index can vary between -100 and +100 points with zero as the neutral midpoint. A negative index value indicates a majority of the consumers polled by the CBS are pessimistic.
The total index is made up of two subindices which reflect consumers' feelings about the general economic climate and about their personal finances and spending plans:
The CBS said that the subindex personal finances was back at the "high level of a year ago".
"The personal finances index runs ahead of the public's spending pattern. The consumer is clearly pulling the economy along at the moment," a spokesman said.
